problems.title: DG embedding alone does not provide full-face right inverse

source_claim.text: Embedding cell-only DG values into hybrid space by averaged traces is said to give straightforward adaptation of trace and lifting theorems.

assumptions: Target interpreted as independent per-face degree-zero polynomials

steps: A cell scalar c induces trace(c,c,c,c).
Boundary vector(1,0,0,0) is outside this range.
Independent hybrid boundary values do not impose existence of a matching DG cell value.
check.result: Embedding is insufficient for a right inverse onto full hybrid face target.

counterevidence: If intended target is the natural DG trace image, displayed datum excluded.
Independent mixed-degree hybrid spaces do contain constructed constantcell/interiorface lift.

impact.scope: Target-space qualification; main independent-hybrid Theorems2.2/2.3 unaffected.

correction.statement: Specify actual DG trace image and prove bounded lifting within cell space, or enrich space for arbitrary face data.
correction.verification: Exact one-cell image calculation verifies range distinction.
correction.limits: No general DG lifting bound established here.
